en.headline: Cavalluna horse show plays last two Hong Kong dates today
en.dek: The European equestrian production ends its first Asian run at Kai Tak Arena with performances at 1pm and 6pm on Sunday.
body: CAVALLUNA – Gate to the Otherworld closes its Hong Kong engagement on Sunday with two remaining performances at 1pm and 6pm in the Grand Hall of Kai Tak Arena at 38 Shing Kai Road. The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists the dates as 8 and 10 to 13 September; a 3pm show on 11 September was cancelled, with refunds handled through the ticketing platforms.

The production, presented in Hong Kong by W2E (HK) Ltd, is making its first appearance in Asia after touring more than 30 European cities. Organisers say the staging uses 54 horses, including Andalusians, Frisians, Lusitanos, Arabians and miniature ponies, together with an international dance ensemble. The Hong Kong Jockey Club is the exclusive presenting partner and cultural host.

Tickets are sold through HK Ticketing and Damai. The Tourism Board lists admission from HK$395 to HK$1,195; Kai Tak Sports Park’s event page also lists higher first-row and premium prices and a six-seat VIP table. A customer service fee applies on the local ticketing platform. The arena is at Kai Tak Sports Park in Kowloon City.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術匯演Cavalluna周日於啟德上演最後兩場
zh.dek: 《CAVALLUNA月影神駒——穿梭異境》亞洲首演今日下午1時及6時在啟德體藝館大館作最後兩場。
body: 歐洲馬術匯演《CAVALLUNA – Gate to the Otherworld》（月影神駒——穿梭異境）周日於啟德體育園啟德體藝館大館上演最後兩場，時間為下午1時及6時，地址為承啟道38號。旅發局列出的場次為9月8日及10日至13日；9月11日下午3時一場已取消，退款安排由售票平台處理。
是次由W2E (HK) Ltd在港主辦，為該製作首次登陸亞洲，此前曾於歐洲30多個城市巡演。主辦單位表示演出動員54匹馬，包括安達盧西亞、弗里斯蘭、盧西塔諾、阿拉伯馬及迷你馬，並有國際舞蹈團參與。香港賽馬會為獨家呈獻及文化合作夥伴。
門票於快達票及大麥發售。旅發局列出票價為港幣395至1,195元，啟德體育園活動頁另列前排、特選及六人貴賓桌票價，本地購票另收顧客服務費。場地在九龍城啟德體育園。
